# Clara

> Clara is an AI marketing team. You work with it in chat and through ready-made jobs called plays. It writes drafts grounded in your brand and knowledge, and nothing is published without approval. These are its user guide pages in Markdown.

## Start here

- [Your first steps with Clara](https://claragtm.com/docs/start-here/quickstart.md): Bring your product, set the context, and choose your first piece.

## Context

- [Give Clara your context](https://claragtm.com/docs/context/brand.md): A recognizable voice starts with clear guidelines and useful sources.

## Create

- [From a brief to a first draft](https://claragtm.com/docs/create/plays.md): Choose a play, write a useful brief, and keep related work together.

## Publish and engage

- [Review and share your work](https://claragtm.com/docs/publish/review-and-approvals.md): Check the details and choose where approvals belong in your workflow.

## Automate

- [Build your marketing team](https://claragtm.com/docs/automate/agents.md): Give agents a role and let workflows turn that direction into repeatable work.
- [Choose your level of autonomy](https://claragtm.com/docs/automate/autonomy.md): From suggestions to automatic publishing, decide what Clara can do on its own.
